niche: a health foundation's FY2027 decision-coaching grants for its collaborative's hospital financial-assistance teams, one per hospital whose 2025 decisions most often left households that the collaborative's 2026 standard makes eligible on their income over the twelve months before applying owing more than half of their balance, when the 2025 policy read income from the three months before the application and much of the region's work follows harvest, packing, fishing, logging and resort seasons
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms every hub correctly and applies criteria 2.1 to 2.5 takes the 2025 policy's yearly figure (the three months before the application times four) as each household's income over the twelve months before it applied and files 5 grants (H11, H15, H17, H23 and H26) where the answer is 16: households whose work follows a season were assessed on their peak or slack quarter, and only each region's own calendar for each kind of work puts their year's income where it was (one calendar pooled across regions or across kinds of work files 6 or 10).
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each applicant household's income over the twelve months before it applied against the poverty line, estimated from the one quarter the 2025 policy recorded with the local seasonal calendar of the household's work: the reference-period problem of income and poverty measurement, where a single period's income misstates the year for earnings that follow a season. Swapping earnings for megawatt-hours or visits breaks it, and replacing the calendar estimate with the recorded quarter times four changes the call.
layer1: three billing systems with their own layouts and codes
UTC timestamps against local application dates
guarantor IDs re-keyed at a billing migration
reapplications and reconsiderations beside first decisions

spine.entity: one financial-assistance application decision, pend, withdrawal or reconsideration a counsellor or the presumptive screening records

driver: A household's yearly income is read from one quarter's income scaled to the year; for households whose earnings follow a season, the scaled quarter overstates the year when the quarter is the season's peak and understates it in the slack months, and the season's timing differs by place and by kind of work, so judging each household against a yearly line by its scaled quarter, or through one calendar pooled across places or across kinds of work, misplaces them; each place's calendar for each kind of work is read from how the scaled quarter moves with the month across that place's households in that work, and each quarter is put on the yearly basis by its own month's factor.
driver_concrete: Each hospital's share of its counsellors' 2025 first-review decisions on households within the free-care limit on their income over the twelve months before applying that left the household owing more than half of its balance (a denial or a 25 percent discount), the twelve-month income rebuilt from the three months the 2025 policy recorded through the calendar of the main earner's kind of work in the hospital's region (the policy's yearly figure averaged by month of application over 2024 and 2025, set against the year's average), not the policy's three months times four and not a calendar pooled across regions or across kinds of work.
stump: A competent analyst who conforms the three hubs, keeps each application's first review and takes the 2025 policy's yearly figure (the three months before the application times four) as the household's income over the twelve months before it applied names 5 hospitals (H11, H15, H17, H23 and H26) for the FY2027 grants, because a household whose pay follows a harvest, packing, fishing, logging or resort season was assessed on one quarter of its year; one calendar for every seasonal kind of work files 6, one for each kind of work across regions 10, one for each region or each hospital across kinds of work 10; only each region's calendar for each kind of work names the 16.

differentiation.task272 (v1): architecture 1 decided on the serial dependence of counsellors' decisions within a working day against its reordering benchmark; architecture 2 decides on households' yearly income rebuilt from one seasonal quarter with the local calendar of their work, a different quantity (income against the poverty line), a different unit (the household) and a different estimator
differentiation.task17: task17's third revision (economics forecasting) applies a mandated, filed calendar factor before carrying a part-period rate forward, with a misfiled decoy block; here no factor is filed, each region's calendar for each kind of work is estimated from the applications themselves, and the trap is pooling it across places or kinds of work whose seasons fall in different months.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: both isolated scored readers corrected each counsellor-day's approve-after-approve contrast for the short-queue bias by permuting the day's determinations and landed the 11 (Gate F)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how strongly each unit's yes-or-no decisions depend on its previous decision inside short sessions whose mix of cases varies; pooling the sessions credits the mix with a positive dependence, comparing within sessions builds in a negative one that short sessions produce on their own, and only the excess over what each session's own decisions would show in any order measures it.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each hospital's sequence effect is the drop in its counsellors' approval rate right after an approval against right after a denial, measured as the excess over what each working day's own decisions would give in any order; pooling consecutive decisions credits the busy outreach days with strings of approvals and clears almost every hospital, and a day-by-day regression charges every hospital with the drop that an eight-decision day shows even when no counsellor is swayed.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst who conforms the three exports and holds each working day's mix fixed by regressing every determination on the counsellor's previous one with a fixed effect per counsellor-day puts 23 of the 31 hospitals over the six-point line, because a short queue shows a drop after an approval with no counsellor swayed, and one who pools consecutive determinations puts 2 over it, because days fed by presumptive referrals string approvals together; only the excess over what each day's own determinations would show in any order puts the 11 hospitals whose counsellors are really swayed over it.
lineage.answer: 11 Decision Coaching Grants ($704,000): H03, H06, H09, H10, H17, H19, H20, H21, H22, H26 and H31
